## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I have included tests or explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] I have identified any third-party material and its applicable license.
- [ ] I have described any UEFN editor-session validation performed.
- [ ] I completed the [CLA acceptance process](../CLA-ACCEPTANCE.md).

## CLA acceptance record

Paste the URL of the contributor's affirmative CLA acceptance comment here.
Maintainers must verify the contributor identity, legal name, accepted CLA
version 1.2, timestamp, and authority before merging or otherwise accepting
this Contribution.
